g.text: Are timing predictions and worker balance improving across main captures?
Only complete captures. Cold starts have no error point. Traversal excludes startup, login and queueing.
Latest: 6 workers; 10/10 routes calibrated. Source and run identifiers are in the adjacent JSON.
